desc: Implement product-indexed bitset DP for positive-product subsequences under `limit`, including parity-dependent signed shifts.
Implement separate bitset reachability DP for non-empty subsequences containing at least one zero, used only when no positive valid product exists.
Verify update ordering, especially `nums[i] == 1`, to prevent selecting one array element multiple times.
Execute sample and boundary-case validation for the completed `Solution.maxProduct` implementation.
